title: Simple machines for kids
examples: Teacher, what is the difference between a ramp and a slide?
Can you show me an example of a lever in our classroom?
Why do we need simple machines?

explain.say: Today we learn about simple machines. These tools make work much easier for us.

items: Tools that help us do work
Make heavy things easier to move

explain.say: Now look! Here it is in 3D: a lever. Can you see the fulcrum and the load? Tap any part, and I will tell you about it.
First we look at the lever. A lever uses a bar and a pivot point. This helps lift or move things.
Next is the wheel and axle. This uses a wheel spinning around a central rod. Think of doorknobs or wheels.
A ramp is a smooth slope. It helps us move things up or down without climbing steep steps.
A pulley uses a wheel and a rope over a fixed point. It helps us lift things by changing the direction of the pull.
In real life, a seesaw is a perfect example of a lever. It uses a pivot point to balance two people.

faq.q: What is the difference between a ramp and a slide?
faq.a: A ramp is a gentle slope for rolling things down. A slide is usually steep and for sliding bodies.
asks: Is a ramp just a gentle slope?
Can I use a ramp for toys?

faq.q: Do all simple machines use ropes?
faq.a: No, not all simple machines use ropes. Levers and ramps do not need ropes to work.
asks: Does a pulley always need a rope?

faq.q: How do I know if something is a lever?
faq.a: You check if it has a bar that pivots around a fixed point. The effort is applied to one end.

faq.q: Is the wheel and axle the same as a pulley?
faq.a: No, they are different. A wheel and axle spins around a central rod. A pulley uses a wheel over a fixed point.

faq.q: Can simple machines lift things that are too heavy?
faq.a: Yes, they help us lift things that would be too heavy to lift by hand alone.
asks: Are they strong enough for big weights?
How much weight can they lift?

facts: A lever needs a pivot point to work correctly.
The wheel and axle system works by spinning two connected parts.
Ramps allow us to move things up or down with less force.
A pulley changes the direction of the force you use.

quiz.say: A wheel spinning on an axle is an example of which simple machine?
quiz.why: The wheel and axle uses a central rod for spinning.

wrong.0: A ramp is a slope, not a spinning mechanism.
wrong.1: A pulley uses a rope over a wheel, not a central axle.
wrong.3: A lever uses a bar that pivots, not a central spinning rod.

quiz.say: Which machine is best for moving a heavy box up to a doorway?
quiz.why: A ramp provides a gentle slope to reduce the force needed to push.

wrong.1: A lever is better for lifting or chopping, not rolling a box up a slope.
wrong.2: A pulley helps lift vertically, not roll horizontally up a slope.
wrong.3: The wheel and axle is for rolling, but the ramp is needed for the change in height.

quiz.say: If you lift a bucket using a rope over a wheel, you are using a:
quiz.why: A pulley uses a wheel and rope to change the direction of your pull.

wrong.1: A lever would require you to push down on one end to lift the other.
wrong.2: A ramp is a slope and cannot lift a bucket vertically.
wrong.3: While it has a wheel, the key action here is the rope over the fixed point.
